question: Which of the following is NOT a tributary of the Godavari river?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hemavati**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Godavari river** is the **largest river** of Peninsular India. 
 
• It is the **second longest** river of the country with length **1465** km.
 
• The old name of Godavari river was **Vriddh (Old) Ganga or the Dakshin (South) Ganga**.
 
• It originates from Maharashtra.
 
• Trbutaries of Godavari are -** the Pravara, the Purna, the Manjra, the Penganga, the Wardha, the Wainganga, the Pranhita the Indravati, the Maner and the Sabri.**
 
• longest tributary - **Manjira**.
 
• largest tributary - **Pranahita**.
 
• **Hemavati** is the tributary of** River Cauvery**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other tributaries of River Cauvery are **Harangi, **Hemavati, **Kabini, Suvarnavathi and Bhavani**.
 
• **Hemavati River**:
 
 
• Starts in the Western Ghats near Balur in **Mudigere taluk of Chikmagalur District **of the state of Karnataka, in southern India.
 
• A dam across the Hemavati was completed in 1979 in Hassan district.
 
• It flows in a southeasterly direction through the states of **Karnataka** and **Tamil Nadu.**
 
 
 
• **Longest river** in India - **Ganga**.
 
• length of Ganga - **2510 km**.
